backtests.method: Day-by-day replay of the live code (research/replay_live.py). Universe: every S&P 500 member since June 2021 plus today's liquid 4.4B to 15B market cap mid-caps, 1,066 names with bars. Eligibility each day: 60-day median dollar volume of at least 50M; revenue growth of 15% or more; an ignition on an earnings-report day is not bought (v5). Same rules as the live account, fills at the next open plus 5 bps.

caveats: The mid-cap pool is today's mid-caps: names that shrank out of it since 2023 are missing, so some losing trades were never counted.
The venue has revenue data for about a third of the mid-caps; names without it were untradeable in the test, as they are live. Which names have data is not random.
Remove the ten best names and the five-year return falls to about 45%: the return is a handful of large winners caught by the trailing stop; the other trades net to about zero.
A single five-year path with about 120 trades has a noise band of at least 50 points: a different start size or a one-basis-point cost change moves the number by that much.
The test re-checked eligibility daily; live re-checks every Sunday.
The worst drawdown, -32%, was still open on the last day of the test. Live starts from inside it.
